scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 40s).

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Paraphrase the customer's core technical issue by summarizing it in your own words, e.g., 'Just to confirm, you're experiencing a complete loss of internet connection with the modem's power light on and internet light blinking red?'

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly ask for a PIN, address, or security question to verify the customer's identity and PASS the 'Verified customer' criterion.

scorecard.name: Set proper expectations
scorecard.coaching: Clearly communicate the expected duration of any action taking more than a few seconds, such as rebooting or holding, to set proper expectations with the customer.

scorecard.name: Provided the appropriate solution
scorecard.coaching: The agent should have escalated the issue to a supervisor or a specialist who could have provided a more effective solution, rather than relying on standard troubleshooting steps that didn't resolve the issue.

result.summary: Customer reports modem issue, no internet, despite reboot attempts.
